objective: Determine whether WP1207 G5 hostile-twin activation via temp-file fsync plus os.replace sufficiently supports its declared interruption/reentry semantics, and distinguish process-interruption atomicity from power-loss crash durability requiring parent-directory persistence.
hypothesis: If the claimed scope includes power-loss durability, the current activation write may need a parent-directory fsync after rename/replace.
counterhypothesis: WP1207 G5 claims only bounded process interruption/reentry inside a scratch hostile twin, so rename atomicity plus file fsync may be sufficient at the declared scope and crash-durability strengthening would be a later separate workpackage property.
